packageRules.description: Debian stays on trixie within contract 1: digest updates only, merged automatically (the images workflow scans and rebuilds).
A Proton GE series (ge10, ge11) only takes fixes of its own series; reviewed by hand, a game may break.
Upstream images of prefabs: grouped weekly; the prefab version must be bumped in the same PR.
